text:
I want to share my positive experience 😍
My sister had orthodontic treatment here for over 2 years. She finished without any delays, and her teeth are perfectly aligned and beautiful, all on schedule. Recently, last month, my front crown came loose, so I went to see the doctor. It turned out the crown I had previously had was just a temporary one, not a permanent crown 😱😱😱 But the previous clinic said it was a ceramic crown!!!! The doctor made a new temporary crown, which is similar to the old one, looks even better, and blends in with my teeth more seamlessly, all for almost 10 times less (14,000 baht at the old clinic, 1,500 baht here). I now have my permanent crown in place, and it looks beautiful.
I want to say thank you so much to the doctor for being so honest and transparent, and for being attentive and considerate of patients like me who have to save up for dental work. If the doctor had wanted to mislead us like the previous clinic, they could have, because we wouldn't have known. 😭 ...

text: Both the doctor and the reception staff provided terrible service, from the first day I went until the day I picked up my retainer. It was awful. The doctor spoke politely, but with a sarcastic and mocking tone. When I asked for a receipt to claim reimbursement, she said she didn't have one, only showing me a sample from another clinic before she would provide one. Even her communication via chat was poor. I'm very dissatisfied. I spent a lot of money at this clinic – fillings, scaling, and retainers – totaling over 3000 baht – but the service I received was not worth it at all. Even the retainer adjustment was terrible. One visit is enough. I won't be coming back. I'll choose another clinic that's more expensive but has better service. Goodbye.

He just gave me a gloriously long lash and said, "That's it, I'm too lazy to write a review." It was terrible. But today, my sister, who I know, told me she went to this clinic and the doctor removed the tartar, simply stating she had tartar and then proceeded with the removal. He didn't ask if I was willing to pay extra for the removal, and she had only had it done four months ago. So, I ended up spending 4,000 baht too. The end. ;)

text:
I went there to get a front tooth filled. The receptionist was very nice, the dentist was gentle, friendly, and gave good advice. The result was very neat. I went during lunchtime on a weekday, so it wasn't crowded and I didn't have to wait in line.

You can contact the admin via Line beforehand to book an appointment; it's very convenient.

You can use your social security benefits. The price will be deducted from your benefits, so you'll pay less. If you want to claim the remaining amount from your health insurance later, just inform the receptionist. They will issue a medical certificate and receipt.
